annotations.title: Gas: fees, action costs, tx estimate (Polygon, Base, Ethereum)

description: Current gas on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param): base fee, priority fee, maxFeePerGas and native/USD, plus the cost in native coin and USD of common actions (approve, swap, aggregator swap; on Polygon also stake, claim, staking v2 exit). Optionally estimate one tx (from, to, data, value). Use before small trades: gas can exceed a small trade's value (often on Ethereum).

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

from.description: Optional: sender of a tx to estimate.

to.description: Optional: target of a tx to estimate.
